meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 增加个人微信通道:适配器通过腾讯官方 iLink Bot API 长轮询收发消息,你手机扫码登录后,机器人就以你的微信账号收发。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 接入个人微信账号、需要扫码登录,或要把某个微信会话接到 agent 组时。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接进 NanoClaw
say.note: 会拉取 channels 分支并复制微信适配器

say.text: 重启服务,把微信登录二维码发我
say.note: 二维码会写到 data/wechat/qr.txt 和日志

say.text: 把这个微信好友接到我的 agent 组
say.note: 运行 wire-dm.ts 完成接线

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw: the adapter long-polls Tencent's official iLink Bot API, you log in by scanning a QR code, and the bot then sends and receives as your WeChat account.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a personal WeChat account to NanoClaw, need to scan a QR code to log in, or wire a WeChat conversation to an agent group.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Fetches the channels branch and copies the adapter

say_en.text: Restart the service and give me the WeChat QR code
say_en.note: The QR is saved to data/wechat/qr.txt and the log

say_en.text: Wire this WeChat contact to my agent group
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts to create the wiring
